_doc: Our addons for the welcome card and the EverlookDB addons filter (src/ours.rs). The set is every catalog entry marked "ours": true (crates/server/addons.json on everlookdb.com) that has a release for the game, minus "exclude". An addon only in the catalog after its first release, so unreleased ones never show. "addons" gives the order and the one-line summary the card shows (the catalog's summary is used for one not listed here). The Price Feed (EverlookDBAuctions_Shared) is never installed this way: the app writes it itself while its switch is on.

addons.summary: Records loot, NPCs and quests for everlookdb.com.

Timestamps, class colours, copy chat and chat history.
Mouseover macros, more macro slots and a ring menu.
Notes on players, shown in tooltips and chat.
An item's disenchant value on its tooltip.
